intro.title: Screen Layout & Sidebar Navigation
intro.subtitle: Master the 3-zone layout, shortcut Ctrl+B, and statutory alerts

narration.text: Welcome back. In Part 2, let's explore MediFlow's clean screen layout, designed for speed and clarity in busy retail pharmacies.
narration.caption: Welcome back! Explore MediFlow's 3-zone layout designed for fast pharmacy operations.

narration.text: On the left is your navigation sidebar. Press Control plus B or click the toggle icon to collapse the sidebar and maximize your billing screen.
narration.caption: Press Ctrl+B to collapse or expand the sidebar for maximum screen workspace.

narration.text: The top bar gives you instant breadcrumb navigation, quick search shortcut Ctrl+K, and a one-click F2 button to start a new bill.
narration.caption: The top bar provides breadcrumbs, quick search (Ctrl+K), and instant F2 billing access.

narration.text: Click the bell icon to review real-time alerts for near-expiry batches, low inventory stock levels, and daily GST register summaries.
narration.caption: Click the bell icon to track near-expiry batches, low stock, and statutory GST alerts.

narration.text: With a flexible layout and live alerts, your counter stays fast and organized. In Part 3, we will master the Command Palette shortcut Ctrl+K.
narration.caption: Master the counter! Watch Part 3 to learn the Command Palette power search (Ctrl+K).

outro.takeaway: Pro Tip: Use Ctrl+B during peak rush hours to maximize billing tables and reduce scrolling.
